edges.rationale: Understanding how foundation models are trained, including design decisions, provides necessary context for understanding the specific difficulties in evaluating them compared to traditional ML models.
Knowledge of the training process and design decisions is needed to understand how models can be adapted without retraining from scratch.
Understanding evaluation difficulties and how to assess intelligent outputs is required to make informed decisions about which foundation model to select for specific applications.
Knowledge of adaptation methods is needed to decide what foundation model to use based on application requirements, since adaptation capabilities influence model selection.
